data.reason_zh: 知识库由在线任务求解学习并跨模拟器/实体迁移，是可复用技能与知识工件，用于改进程序搜索。

scope_support.feedback_quote: learned from embodied data and online task solving
scope_support.object_quote: a hierarchical knowledge base combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge of affordances, spatial relations, and action effects
